name: SES Raceday

origin.basis: ENVE Composites USA publishes the official store (site footer).

manufacturing.basis: ENVE does not state where the tire is made.

positioning: ENVE's lightest tubeless-ready race-day tire for road racing, criteriums and time trials.

availability.note: Sold by ENVE's US store; the European storefront was not read for this tire.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: ENVE says it prioritizes speed over puncture resistance and longevity; the lab tread-puncture score is low (37).
Hookless use is not stated on the product page.

image.shown: SES Raceday mounted on an ENVE wheel, from ENVE's product page.
image.alt: ENVE SES Raceday road tire mounted on a deep carbon wheel, sidewall logo visible

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: Light and very lively on the front wheel; recommended for racing.
A super-fast tire with surprisingly good puncture protection.
Very fast through a 1,000 km ultra race on rough and smooth roads, with great wet grip, but after two sealed punctures and 600 km more a pothole tore the sidewall beyond plugging.
Loved the feel, but it was very, very puncture-prone.
Incredibly fast with a nice feel, but simply too fragile.

checks.note: 29 mm test page plus two owners on the Tufo Comtura Prima TT test
